pick.headline: Bush and Gorbachev sign a chemical weapons accord
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of June 1, 1990, carried Moscow TASS on Baker saying the Soviets had agreed a chemical weapons destruction accord, and Moscow Television on Gorbachev's White House welcome.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 106, 1 June 1990
evidence.snippet: …ed out at the superpower summit.
